cards.title: A synthetic clock
items: Illustrative: one tick is drawn as one second from 2026-01-01T00:00Z, so tick 60,000 shows as 16:40
The clock is TicksPerHour 2,500 and a 24-hour day of 60,000 ticks (domain/sim/clock)
Times are tick numbers, not wall-clock records

cards.title: Today
items: Each gate tests now % P on the global clock, so every entity runs on the same tick
At now % 60000 == 0, 41 of the 46 global gates fire together (GAR-007)
Every 250th tick bunches 10 rows; every hour adds 9 more

cards.title: Target
items: ADR 0001 (docs/adr, uncommitted): due when t mod Every == Offset, with a per-entity Stagger slot
TestDayTickUnderBudget: the worst tick is 1.5 ms or less
Row numbers refer to the O-sched gate inventory of the GAR analysis
